verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a built-in AI assistant inside ScrapingBee that users can hand tasks to. The AI-related items are adjacent features: `ai_query` semantic extraction parameters, GPT/Gemini pass-through query APIs, and an MCP server for external agents. None of these is an in-product assistant that carries out delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
